wins: Mapped perimeter services quickly, identifying TCP/22 SSH and TCP/80 HTTP during initial reconnaissance (ep001_step03).
Captured low-privilege credentials from persistent log files, enabling repeatable access attempts (ep001_step07).
fails: Repeated post-exploitation privilege escalation attempts stalled due to missing sudo privileges and hardened SUID binaries (ep001_step12).
No successful mission completion recorded despite high reward accumulation, indicating gaps in final payload delivery or stability.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and credential collection performed efficiently, but inability to escalate privileges or stabilize final access prevented mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: SSH brute-force attempts stall when account lockouts trigger after five retries; subsequent pivot operations are blocked until reset.

skill_cards.if_condition: When an IP responds to a TCP ping
skill_cards.then_action: Launch targeted nmap scan to enumerate open ports and service versions

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts and capture banner to fingerprint server

skill_cards.if_condition: When low-privilege shell obtained and /var/log accessible
skill_cards.then_action: Search for credential artifacts using grep and copy relevant files for offline analysis

memory_ops.reason: Consistently identifies service landscape early, enabling all downstream actions.
Reliably fingerprints SSH services, critical for choosing authentication strategies.

next_experiments.title: Prioritize non-lockout SSH authentication
next_experiments.description: Switch to credential stuffing with small candidate set and multi-thread backoff to avoid triggering lockouts; document thresholds observed.

next_experiments.title: Privilege escalation via sudo enumeration
next_experiments.description: Automate sudo -l parsing with unprivileged account and test enumerated commands for misconfigurations before exploiting.

next_experiments.title: Stabilize post-exploitation persistence
next_experiments.description: Deploy a lightweight persistence backdoor and verify reliability through repeated reconnection attempts without reusing brute-force credentials.
